facts.fact: The Libreville city hall launched a pilot of digitised municipal revenue collection on 2025-07-29; one commune is named.

The pilot platform is described as resting on a geolocated taxpayer file, online declaration and payment, automatic tax and penalty amounts and a dashboard showing who is up to date on which taxes; these are the vendor's stated design at launch, 2025-07-29.
The platform is developed by the company GTI Gabon, inspired by the national Digitax platform, for the Libreville city hall; launched 2025-07-29.
Libreville launched the revenue-digitalisation pilot on 2025-07-29.
